description: Translink Northern Ireland Railway Real Time Passenger Information is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by OpenDataNI. This API provides near real time information about arrivals and departures for the Translink rail stations. Results are cached for 2 minutes for performance reasons. Coverage: OpenDataNI. The portal files it under the publisher OpenDataNI. Its tags are NIR, Public Transport, RTPI, Rail, Timetables. The portal shows 2022-04-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
